description: DailyPhotoTips.com is a free photography education site with structured guides, articles, a glossary, and practical calculators for photographers. It also provides an MCP server so AI assistants can use those tools and answer photography questions from the site's newsletter archive.
summary: DailyPhotoTips exposes a public markdown-readable content surface on its website and an OAuth-protected MCP server at `mcp.dailyphototips.com` for photography tools, glossary lookups, and question answering; no separate REST/GraphQL API or CLI was documented.
